read_first: the one source population pool actually recruited from
selection mechanics and source/destination capability state only when the recruitment test changes composition
write_order: resolve applicant count and selection from the source pool without pre-creating ordinary mass-force individuals
remove only accepted personnel from the source population; rejected applicants remain in the source pool
update an aggregate force/formation once with accepted count and selected composition; large ordinary forces remain aggregate

for house.tang, create one persistent person core and one persistent lightweight individual profile for every accepted Sword Manor member inside the bounded House registry and place each ID in exactly one cohort roster_refs array
derive House cohort capability/category summaries from the saved individual profiles; cohort/section changes never reroll an established member
provision conserved onboarding equipment and record only affected indexes/history
invariants: Recruitment never creates personnel from nothing.
Mass force, village, country, clan, mercenary and civilian-security recruitment remains aggregate and cannot automatically emit named person owners.
Sword Manor membership is identity-preserving: every accepted member receives one stable person core plus persistent individual-lite capability/progression without one-file-per-person write fan-out.
House Tang cohort references are organizational/training placement; cohort summaries are derived and never character authority.
Promotion or cohort reassignment preserves the same person ID, saved numeric profile, aptitudes, repertoire progression, provenance and history unless a lawful mechanic changes those facts.
A descriptive source category such as hunter or villager is stored inside a pool/profile when causally relevant and does not require its own file.
Selection changes the accepted population profile; eight selected from fifty are not treated as eight unselected random civilians.
Compression cannot improve aptitude, age/body composition, capability, experience, survival, equipment, promotion or training outcomes.
A governed population pool is recruitable only when its exact jurisdiction has recruitment_rights=true; population ownership alone never bypasses jurisdiction policy.
